profile.name: Fabrizio Giovanni Fatecha Vera
profile.title: JavaScript Developer
profile.summary: JavaScript Developer with 2+ years of experience building scalable web applications and RESTful APIs. Proficient in NestJS, Vite, and PostgreSQL, with hands-on experience deploying to Azure and AWS. Passionate about clean code and test-driven development. Seeking remote opportunities at fintechs.

highlights: Designed a high-availability hospital triage system using Node.js and PostgreSQL, improving patient processing efficiency by 25%.
Reduced API response time by 40% by implementing Redis caching layers, significantly enhancing overall user experience and system throughput.
Engineered a robust task queue system with BullMQ, eliminating 95% of data races and ensuring transactional consistency in the database.
Automated data integrity protocols by designing PostgreSQL triggers, reducing manual data cleanup tasks by 30%.
Streamlined the delivery lifecycle by creating CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, accelerating deployment frequency by 50%.
Architected the migration of on-premise infrastructure to Azure App Service, achieving 99.9% system availability and reducing server maintenance overhead.
Standardized code bundling and multi-environment deployments by writing optimized YAML configurations, reducing configuration errors.
Optimized project management and feature tracking through custom Jira dashboards, increasing the team's feature shipping rate into production.
Hardened system security by applying throttling and rate-limiting to public endpoints, effectively mitigating brute-force and DoS risks.
Developed high-performance landing pages using Vite and React, improving initial load times (LCP) and user retention metrics.
Implemented real-time bidirectional communication using WebSockets, enabling instantaneous data updates and a more interactive user experience.
Mentored and led a team of 2 developers, implementing an agile workflow that improved overall sprint velocity and code quality.
Resolved critical application incidents by performing advanced data querying and manipulation with PL/SQL and SQL, ensuring 100% ticket tracking through Jira.
Automated repetitive support tasks by developing custom SQL scripts for data insertion, reducing manual effort on monotonous issues by 40%.
Architected and deployed internal web applications that allowed support analysts to execute automated fixes directly from Jira cases, streamlining the troubleshooting workflow.
Decreased overall SLA response times as a core member of an experimental development task force, significantly improving ticket resolution speed.
Executed high-volume database scripts for massive cashback accruals, ensuring accurate and timely credit distribution to thousands of bank users.
